senses.en_definition: To enter; to go or come into a place or something.
Of the sun, moon, or another celestial body: to set.
To attend or report for work or school, or be admitted to an institution such as a hospital.
To join an organization or group, or convert to a religion.
To reach a particular age, time, or stage.
To be included, counted, or classified as belonging to a category.

collocations.en: be counted; be taken into account

senses.en_definition: To take part or become involved in something; to intervene.
Of money or income: to come in or be received.
In the expression masuk akal: to make sense or be reasonable or plausible.

messages.en: I'm at the door already. Can I come in now?
Just come on in. The door's unlocked. I'm in the kitchen.
Okay, I'm coming in. I've brought some cakes.
I've bought some milk. Where should I put it?
Just put it in the fridge, okay? There's room on the bottom shelf.
I'm outside your place now. Can I come in?
Go ahead and come in. The door's unlocked. I'm just in the kitchen.
There's a community clean-up here this Sunday. Want to join in?
Yes! I'll bring a broom along too.
